hooks.text: 十六位像素赛博关卡配六十余把武器
hooks.excerpt: Fight through randomly generated levels in glorious 16bit-style retro pixel art and listen to an awesome dynamic soundtrack while you blast away robots using one of 60+ weapons.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 解锁盟友与欧洲英雄之魂赋予能力
hooks.excerpt: Upgrade your character, find items, unlock allies that will help you and find the spirits of European heroes that will give you special powers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在人无所有的企业欧洲掀起反叛
hooks.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the dystopian Europe of the year 20XX, where the Lucis Lux Mega-Corporation owns everything and the people own nothing. You play the role of Human 10.28, a man who decides he had enough.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
